name: @hotel/backend
description: HotelOS backend — Hotel Nayel's operations platform, powered by AURIC Core (a separate deployment/database from Mizan and Atlas: see app/app.module.ts).

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build

comment_dependencies: Deliberately no dependencies of its own, exactly like atlas/backend: every package is installed at the repo root (../../node_modules) and Core's source (imported via @core/*) is compiled as part of this package, so a second copy of @nestjs/*, fastify, kysely or reflect-metadata here would create a dual-package hazard. Always `npm install` at the repo root, never inside hotel-project/backend.
